content.short: Visualize Encryption See how ENCOINS protects your privacy through advanced encryption.
content.description: Cardano Native Tokens with Encrypted Redeeming Values. Protect your privacy with ENCOINS. ENCOINS uses advanced encryption to protect your ADA amount. When you mint ENCOINS, your ADA value is converted to lovelace and encrypted, and only you have the key to decrypt it later. ENCOINS provides a revolutionary approach to privacy in the Cardano ecosystem. Private Minting Mint ENCOINS with encrypted values that only you can access.
